code:
import requests, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
os.makedirs('/tmp/pdb', exist_ok=True)
def dl(p,asm=True):
    f=f"/tmp/pdb/{p}_{'asm1' if asm else 'full'}.cif"
    if not os.path.exists(f):
        url=f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}-assembly1.cif" if asm else f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.cif"
        open(f,"wb").write(requests.get(url,timeout=300).content)
    return f
def parse(path):
    lines=open(path).read().splitlines(); cols=[]; rows=[]; i=0
    while i<len(lines):
        if lines[i].startswith('loop_'):
            j=i+1; tmp=[]
            while j<len(lines) and lines[j].strip().startswith('_'): tmp.append(lines[j].strip()); j+=1
            if tmp and tmp[0].startswith('_atom_site.'):
                cols=[t.split('.')[1] for t in tmp]; k=j
                while k<len(lines) and not lines[k].startswith('#') and not lines[k].startswith('loop_'):
                    s=lines[k].strip()
                    if s: rows.append(s.split())
                    k+=1
                break
        i+=1
    d=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=cols)
    for c in d.columns: d[c]=d[c].astype(str).str.replace('"','',regex=False).str.replace("'",'',regex=False)
    for c in ['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']: d[c]=pd.to_numeric(d[c],errors='coerce')
    d['auth_seq_id']=pd.to_numeric(d['auth_seq_id'],errors='coerce')
    return d[(d.type_symbol!='H')&(d.label_comp_id!='HOH')].reset_index(drop=True)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    dd=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,dd])@U.T
    return R, qc-R@pc
h=parse(dl("5CCB")); ref=parse(dl("1EHZ",asm=False))
def c1p(df,ch):
    s=df[(df.label_asym_id==ch)&(df.label_atom_id=="C1")].drop_duplicates('auth_seq_id').sort_values('auth_seq_id')
    return dict(zip(s.auth_seq_id.astype(int), s[['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']].to_numpy(float)))
bound=c1p(h,'C'); refc=c1p(ref,'A')
RIGID=list(range(1,8))+list(range(66,73))+list(range(27,32))+list(range(39,44))
rig=[n for n in RIGID if n in bound and n in refc]
P=np.array([bound[n] for n in rig]); Q=np.array([refc[n] for n in rig]); R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
rig_rmsd=np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1)**2).mean())
common=sorted(set(bound)&set(refc))
disp={n: float(np.linalg.norm((R@np.array(bound[n]))+t-refc[n])) for n in common}
def heav(ch):
    s=h[h.label_asym_id==ch]; return s[['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']].to_numpy(float), s.auth_seq_id.to_numpy(int)
rna_xyz,rna_res=heav('C')
def cb(ch):
    o,_=heav(ch); hit=cKDTree(o).query_ball_point(rna_xyz,4.0)
    return {int(rna_res[i]) for i,x in enumerate(hit) if x}
c_T6=cb('B'); c_61=cb('A')|cb('A-2')
cls={}
for n in disp:
    if n in c_T6 and n in c_61: cls[n]='both'
    elif n in c_T6: cls[n]='TRMT6'
    elif n in c_61: cls[n]='TRMT61A'
    else: cls[n]='none'
D=pd.DataFrame({'nt':list(disp),'disp':[disp[n] for n in disp],'cls':[cls[n] for n in disp]}).sort_values('nt')

# clean comparison: any TRMT61A contact vs TRMT6-exclusive vs no contact
g61any=D[D.cls.isin(['TRMT61A','both'])].disp.values
g6only=D[D.cls=='TRMT6'].disp.values
gnone =D[D.cls=='none'].disp.values
u,p=mannwhitneyu(g61any,g6only,alternative='greater'); A=u/(len(g61any)*len(g6only))
u3,p3=mannwhitneyu(g6only,gnone,alternative='two-sided'); A3=u3/(len(g6only)*len(gnone))
print(f"Rigid-core superposition RMSD (24 C1'): {rig_rmsd:.2f} A  -> this is the measurement floor\n")
print(f"any TRMT61A contact (n={len(g61any)}) median {np.median(g61any):.1f} A")
print(f"TRMT6-exclusive     (n={len(g6only)}) median {np.median(g6only):.1f} A")
print(f"no protein contact  (n={len(gnone)}) median {np.median(gnone):.1f} A\n")
print(f"TRMT61A-contacted > TRMT6-exclusive : U={u:.0f}, one-sided p={p:.2e}, effect size A={A:.2f}")
print(f"TRMT6-exclusive vs no contact       : two-sided p={p3:.3f}, A={A3:.2f}  (indistinguishable from baseline)")

ELEM=[('acceptor stem',1,7,'#e2e8f0'),('D-arm',10,25,'#fbd38d'),('anticodon arm',26,44,'#bee3f8'),
      ('variable',44,48,'#d6bcfa'),('T-arm',49,65,'#9ae6b4'),("3' CCA",73,76,'#fed7d7')]
col={'TRMT6':'#c05621','TRMT61A':'#2f855a','both':'#6b46c1','none':'#cbd5e0'}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(14.5,8),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[2.3,1]})
ax=axes[0]
for nm,a,b,c in ELEM: ax.axvspan(a-.5,b+.5,color=c,alpha=.45,zorder=0)
ax.bar(D.nt,D.disp,color=[col[c] for c in D.cls],width=.88,zorder=3)
ax.axhline(rig_rmsd,color='k',ls='--',lw=1.2,zorder=4)
ax.text(1,rig_rmsd+0.5,f"measurement floor {rig_rmsd:.1f} A (rigid-core RMSD)",fontsize=8)
for nm,a,b,c in ELEM: ax.text((a+b)/2,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.96,nm,ha='center',fontsize=8,style='italic')
for n in [15,16,17,18,19]: ax.annotate('',xy=(n,D.set_index('nt').disp[n]+0.6),xytext=(n,D.set_index('nt').disp[n]+3.2),
                                        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',color='#2f855a',lw=1.3))
ax.text(17,D.set_index('nt').disp[17]+4,'displaced D-loop,\nheld by TRMT61A',ha='center',fontsize=8.5,color='#2f855a')
ax.text(53,1.2,'T-stem held by TRMT6,\nat canonical position',ha='center',fontsize=8.5,color='#c05621')
ax.set_xlabel('tRNA position (Sprinzl numbering)'); ax.set_ylabel("C1' displacement from the\ncanonical tRNA fold (A)")
ax.set_title('Which subunit grips the remodelled tRNA? 5CCB tRNA3Lys against free yeast tRNA-Phe (1EHZ)',fontsize=12)
hs=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=col[k]) for k in ['TRMT6','TRMT61A','both','none']]
ax.legend(hs,['contacts TRMT6 only','contacts TRMT61A only','contacts both','no protein contact'],fontsize=9,ncol=4,loc='upper center')
ax.set_xlim(-1,77)

ax=axes[1]
PAIRS=[('G18:U55',18,55),('G19:C56',19,56),('G15:C48',15,48),('T54:A58',54,58),
       ('U8:A14',8,14),('G22:G46',22,46),('G26:A44',26,44),('A9:A23',9,23)]
nm=[p[0] for p in PAIRS]
fr=[np.linalg.norm(np.array(refc[i])-np.array(refc[j])) for _,i,j in PAIRS]
bo=[np.linalg.norm(np.array(bound[i])-np.array(bound[j])) for _,i,j in PAIRS]
y=np.arange(len(PAIRS))
ax.barh(y-0.2,fr,height=.38,color='#718096',label='free tRNA (1EHZ)')
ax.barh(y+0.2,bo,height=.38,color='#9b2c2c',label='bound to TRMT6/TRMT61A (5CCB)')
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(nm,fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("C1'-C1' distance across the tertiary pair (A)")
ax.set_title('Tertiary pairs of the tRNA elbow: the three that break are all gripped by TRMT61A',fontsize=10)
for i,(f_,b_) in enumerate(zip(fr,bo)):
    if b_-f_>5: ax.text(b_+0.5,i+0.2,f'+{b_-f_:.0f} A',va='center',fontsize=8,color='#9b2c2c')
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5,loc='lower right'); ax.grid(axis='x',alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
